toast.campaignIdRequired: A default Campaign ID is required to enable AI calling.

enableCard.title: AI Calling
enableCard.description: When enabled, leads are first called by the AI voice agent. The recording and AI summary appear on the lead profile, and a counsellor is assigned only when the outcome rules below say so.
enableCard.showInLeadList: Show the AI-call button on lead rows
enableCard.showInLeadListHint: Controls only the manual robot button in lead lists. Automated AI workflows run regardless of this toggle.
enableCard.inboundLeadCaptureHint: For an inbound AI helpline: when someone calls and isn't already a lead, a lead is created (matched by phone, so repeat callers aren't duplicated) and the call attaches to it — so it shows in Recent Leads and the Call Log, and you can follow up. Off means unknown callers' calls are recorded but no lead is made.
enableCard.providerHint: The AI calling agent used for this institute. The credentials and campaign below are for the selected provider.

campaigns.title: Campaigns / Agents

description.part1: Register each AI campaign id and give it an agent
description.part3: , not the raw id — pick the same name once per provider and switching provider resolves to the right id automatically. Tag each Outbound (you dial) or Inbound (they dial your AI line); Inbound ids classify incoming webhooks (matched to the lead by phone).

campaigns.empty: No campaigns registered yet. Add one and tag it Inbound to enable inbound-call detection.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: API credentials for this institute's AI calling provider. The token and webhook secret are stored encrypted and never shown again.
credentials.webhookHelp: Authenticates the provider's end-of-call webhook. Hand your AI provider the URL {{webhookPath}}?instituteId=…&token=<this secret>.

retryCard.title: Retries & Calling Shifts
retryCard.description: If a lead doesn't answer, the AI retries within these limits before giving up. Retries are only placed inside the shifts below.
retryCard.retryGapHint: How long the bot waits before re-dialing a no-answer lead.
retryCard.callingShiftsHint: Time windows the bot may (re)dial in. Add multiple shifts (e.g. morning + evening). Applies to the timed retry re-dialer; immediate new-lead, manual and bulk calls fire right away.
retryCard.connectThresholdHint: Shorter calls count as “not connected” and are retried.

outcomeAction.title: Outcome → Action
outcomeAction.description: For each AI-call outcome, choose what happens. Outcomes left off both lists are retried until max retries, then assigned to a human. Add custom outcomes below for the dispositions your own AI agent returns.
outcomeAction.addOutcomePlaceholder: Add a custom outcome (e.g. Wrong Number)

assignmentCard.title: Counsellor Assignment
assignmentCard.description: How a counsellor is picked when a lead qualifies (or when retries are exhausted).
assignmentCard.assignExhausted: Assign no-answer leads to a human after retries are exhausted
